messages:
sre-zoe: getting alerts -> etcd leader churn + apiserver conn resets in eu-west1 around 09:07 UTC. lots of short lived connections to apiserver and controller-manager lease renewals failing.
infra-lee: correlated with hardware telemetry: eth0 rx_errors climbing on the ToR uplink for rack eu-west1-rack-12. `ifconfig` shows RX errors and drops on the switch-facing interface.
platform-raj: interesting — our GPU onboarding spike started at 09:05 when a customer job autoscaled a bunch of model loaders; that increased egress and pushed a lot of flows through the rack NAT gateway. Possible asymmetric route + microbursts causing switch buffers to drop.
sre-zoe: logs: apiserver `error serving request: read tcp 10.64.0.1:6443->10.64.1.8:56732: read: connection reset by peer` repeated. controller-manager: `E0313 09:08:12.021 leader_election.go:266] failed to acquire lease: context deadline exceeded`
infra-lee: pulled dmesg from the ToR host: `eth0: NIC rx ring full, drop 512 packets`, plus switch reported CRC errors on that port. I'm opening a ticket with colo to check optics but that will take time.
platform-raj: short-term mitigation ideas: 1) reduce parallel outbound connections from GPU nodes (image pullers/healthchecks) 2) move critical control-plane egress for kubelets off the congested NAT (use node-local egress or bypass path) 3) increase kube-apiserver tolerance to transient read errors (longer keepalives/retries).
oncall-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-201 - ToR RX errors + egress microburst causing control-plane connection resets. Severity: Sev3.
sre-zoe: agree with mitigations. Can infra patch a node-localregistry mirror behind the same rack to reduce egress? That would cut out NAT usage for image pulls.
infra-lee: we can stand up a temporary node-local registry on the rack-local subnet, yes. Will need ~20m to bootstrap and seed images, low risk.
platform-raj: also recommend throttling the GPU DaemonSet ramp: set maxUnavailable to 50% and add a 30s pause between batches. I'll prepare a k8s patch.
sre-zoe: tweak controller-manager flags as a fallback: `--leader-election-renew-deadline=35s` and `--leader-election-retry-period=12s`. Apiserver flag: bump `--keep-alive-timeout` from 15s -> 45s. Low-risk and should tolerate transient packet drops.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary: controller-manager configmap rollout on eu-west1 at 09:25 UTC.
infra-lee: temp node-local registry up and seeded (images for top 3 GPU jobs). Monitoring SNAT translation count dropping by ~40% for that rack.
sre-zoe: after mitigations, apiserver p95 down from 820ms to 180ms, etcd leader stable, controller-manager leader renewed. Good short term.
platform-raj: follow-ups: 1) add per-rack SNAT dashboards and ToR optics alerts 2) evaluate pinning registry egress to a different subnet to avoid noisy racks 3) implement node-local egress as a pattern for high-churn workloads.
infra-lee: costing note: running temporary node-local registry is cheap but long-term we'd either pay for more NAT capacity or re-architect egress; I'll draft cost options.
sre-zoe: I'll write a short postmortem and include runbook steps: detect ToR rx errors -> shift registry pulls -> throttle onboarding -> escalate to colo. Thanks team. :heart:
